Incorporate favorite activities, like drawing, to celebrate progress. Be patient and maintain brief, upbeat discussions about the process.
rejected: To potty-train a toddler afraid of the toilet, start with gentle encouragement and make the process fun. Use a potty chair instead of a regular toilet to lessen fear. Offer rewards and praise for attempts and successes. Read books or watch videos about potty training together. Be patient and avoid pressure.
